headline: New this week: Aegean wants non-type-rated A320/ATR first officers in Athens with just 70 h PIC (closes 31 Dec), and Wizz opens an Albanian cadet academy. Ryanair and KLM say pilot hiring is slowing.
prep_tip: Wizz's last 2026 Budapest assessments run 17 Nov–5 Dec and Aegean closes on 31 Dec: if you're applying, practise the online aptitude tests and refresh your ATPL theory, starting with Performance and Mass & Balance.
